items.followUp: Define centripetal force and write its formula.

rubric.why: Checks that the answer identifies the acceleration in circular motion and its inward direction.
rubric.description: Defines centripetal acceleration as acceleration directed towards the centre of a circular path.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as acceleration in circular motion directed towards the centre.
Award 1 mark for a correct expression, a_c = v²/r.

modelAnswer: Centripetal acceleration is the acceleration of an object moving in a circular path, directed towards the centre of the circle.

items.followUp: Define torque and state its SI unit.

rubric.description: Defines torque as the turning effect of a force about a pivot or axis.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying torque as the turning or rotational effect of a force.

rubric.why: Checks the mathematical relationship for torque.
rubric.description: Writes torque as force multiplied by the perpendicular distance from the pivot to the line of action of the force.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct equation using force and perpendicular distance.

modelAnswer: Torque is the turning effect of a force about a pivot or axis.
Torque = force × perpendicular distance from the pivot to the line of action of the force.

items.followUp: Define work and write its formula.

rubric.description: Defines power as the rate of doing work.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that power is work done per unit time.
Award 1 mark for a correct formula, P = W/t.

modelAnswer: Power is the rate of doing work.
P = work done / time taken = W/t.
